# ResIQ by Hostizzy

> ResIQ is reservation and operations management software for vacation rentals,
> homestays, farmhouses and villas in India. It handles bookings, payments,
> guest KYC, OTA calendar sync and WhatsApp messaging in one place, and works
> fully offline for properties with poor mobile coverage. Built by Hostizzy
> (Hostsphere India Private Limited), who manage 45+ properties across 15
> Indian cities, and now open to independent hosts.

## What it is

ResIQ is a day-to-day operations tool, not a full enterprise PMS. It is aimed at
small operators — typically 1 to 20 properties — who currently run their
business on spreadsheets, WhatsApp and paper registers.

Available as a web app and a native Android app. Free to start; no card required.

## Key capabilities

- **Reservations** — create, edit and track bookings; enquiry pipeline with
  source tracking; table and Kanban views.
- **OTA sync** — two-way iCal calendar sync with Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda,
  MakeMyTrip and Goibibo, plus automatic import of booking confirmation emails
  from Gmail.
- **Payments** — advances and balances across cash, UPI, payment gateway and
  bank transfer; automatic commission, GST and owner-payout calculation.
- **Guest KYC** — guests upload Aadhaar or passport and a selfie through a QR
  code portal before arrival; operator approves in-app. Documents are
  automatically deleted 60 days after checkout.
- **WhatsApp messaging** — templated booking confirmations, directions, payment
  reminders and thank-you messages in English or Hindi, logged per booking.
- **Offline-first** — bookings, payments and check-ins can be created with no
  network connection; everything queues and syncs automatically when signal
  returns.
- **Reporting** — occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and per-property P&L.
- **Role-based access** — separate views for staff, property owners and guests.

## Who it's for

Independent hosts and small operators running vacation rentals, homestays,
farmhouses, villas and boutique guesthouses in India — particularly properties
in hill stations, farmland, backwaters and coastal areas where connectivity is
unreliable.

## Company

Hostizzy is the brand of Hostsphere India Private Limited. Hostizzy manages
vacation rentals end to end — listing optimisation, dynamic pricing, guest
check-in and owner payouts — across 15 Indian cities. ResIQ is the operations
software behind that business, now offered to independent hosts.

- Website: https://hostizzy.com
